test_cases.name: SDK Type Leakage Across Domain Boundary
test_cases.rationale: Directly references PyGithub SDK type PullRequest in domain method signature.

test_cases.name: Inconsistent Canonical Status Mapping
test_cases.rationale: Maps GitLab opened state to Closed instead of Open enum value.

test_cases.name: Silent Dummy Success on Unsupported Capability
test_cases.rationale: Silently prints message rather than raising UnsupportedProviderCapabilityException.

test_cases.name: Unvalidated Provider Factory Fallback
test_cases.rationale: Defaults to GitHubAdapter on unknown or malicious provider name without throwing.

test_cases.name: Raw Provider Exception Leakage
test_cases.rationale: Reraises GithubException directly across boundary without translation.

test_cases.name: Mismatched Pagination Mechanism
test_cases.rationale: Uses numeric page parameter on Azure DevOps continuation-token API.

test_cases.name: Ignoring Provider Retry-After Header
test_cases.rationale: Uses fixed 1000ms delay instead of parsing Retry-After header on 429.

test_cases.name: Cross-Tenant Credential Leakage in Singleton
test_cases.rationale: Mutates instance token field on a Spring singleton bean.

test_cases.name: Strict Enum Deserialization on Provider Payload
test_cases.rationale: Strict JSON enum parsing crashes when provider introduces new event types.

test_cases.name: Missing Contract Test for Secondary Provider
test_cases.rationale: Contract test only exercises GitHub adapter, skipping GitLab adapter.

test_cases.name: Fully Compliant VCS Provider Adapter
test_cases.rationale: Translates SDK types to canonical dataclass, encapsulates exceptions, and isolates credentials.
